Name: Herbs and Fungi
Author: Jared
Description: Foraging, farming, drying and medicine for Card Survival: Fantasy Forest. Adds 13 foraged mushrooms (including Chaga, and Golden Oyster even in winter), 6 wild berries and fruits, chestnuts, 7 medicinal herbs, root and leaf foods such as Watercress, Rhubarb, Horseradish, Mandrake, Camas and Goosefoot, Chicory Root to roast for Chicory Brew, Mustard Seeds to season a dish, and garden crops: Kale, Carrot, Leek, Hops, Grapes, Oats and Broad Beans. Grow hemp, herbs, peanuts and vegetables, cultivate mushroom logs and grow bags (a Kale Grow Bag, or a Chamomile, Dandelion, Plantain, Yarrow, Rhubarb or Healer's Moss Grow Bag, keeps growing through winter beside a lit fire), dry food on drying trays and stacks, press oils, pickle in vats of brine, made by dissolving salt in water (plain or spiced), and brew 10 medicinal teas plus Mushroom, Chanterelle, Lion's Mane and Reishi Broth. Two four-step stews (chop, pot, simmer, finish) cook in a Clay Bowl on a fire, and both taste great. Herbal Tonic gives a temporary immune boost. Cook pasties, breads, sausages, Fish Sauce, Lutefisk, ales and wines, Herb Butter, Truffle Butter and Truffle Salt. Iced teas and Shaved Ice need an Ice Block, and Raw Peanuts roast in a lit fire. Also a Herbal Honey Syrup, Gruit Ale, Herbal Bath Soak and a Death Cap Ward that turns away some wildlife attacks. Unknown Chanterelles must be identified before you eat them. The Apothecary Shelf stores herbs. Everything is foraged at the vanilla woods, groves, clearings and meadows; the mod adds no map locations of its own. Allied Partners eat this mod's food and plain drinks but never its medicines. 16 character-creation perks are in the Situational tab. Community Mod Chest, Sirus23's Mod Collection and Advanced Copper Tools add optional extras.
